author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
How did one couple’s concerns about their adoption help uncover something much bigger? 

Hear from Rachel and Dan Christensen as they describe the moment they realized their experience was not an isolated one, in Part 2 of our series “Their adoption helped exposed a ‘baby mill,’” drawn from FRONTLINE and Retro Report’s documentary Baby Brokers.
title: They Helped Expose an Adoption "Baby Mill" 2/3

author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
What happens when the adoption you’ve been hoping for moves forward, but the process raises troubling questions?

Hear from Rachel and Dan Christensen, whose adoption of their son led them to report concerns about the process, in Part 1 of our series “Their adoption exposed a ‘baby mill,’” drawn from FRONTLINE and Retro Report’s documentary Baby Brokers.
title: They Helped Expose an Adoption "Baby Mill" 1/3
